body: I was unable to reproduce the issue, maybe is OS related. Could you provide an MRP with the problematic model to make sure is not related with the model file?

The problem is not in 3D models directly, but in its textures. When 3D mode is detected, its textures is being imported using VRAM compression. And this leads to a crash. I've attached an empty project below with a simple texture. If I select VRAM compression on that texture, the engine will crush. I still don't thing you are able to reproduce this, as the problem seems to be in my binary exclusively. If only I can build godot statically to provide the executable (which I see challenging both for me and for you). I am going to compile the engine including debug information and do some debugging.

It looks like the crash is happening inside your Vulkan driver while Godot is trying to create a Vulkan instance. This is likely a bug in MESA. Do you have the latest drivers? If you do, could you try rolling back to an older stable version of the driver? If not, could you try updating to the latest version of the drivers?

As a temporary workaround you can disable the [`compress_with_gpu`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_projectsettings.html#class-projectsettings-property-rendering-textures-vram-compression-compress-with-gpu) project setting

I have `mesa-25.0.5` installed, while the latest available is `25.1.0` (masked for testing). Stable version is `24.3.4`.
The problem is solved by installing `mesa-25.1.0`. VRAM compression seems to work, and no more segfaults there.
This issue should be closed now. Thank you for help!
